crossRefs.note: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows…
Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?
Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in…
This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all: yes also, the heart of the sons of…
He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.
Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and said to him, “This is what Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, says: ‘How long will…
Yahweh said to Moses, “How long will this people despise me? and how long will they not believe in me, for all the…
“How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools…
But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
You frustrate the plan of the poor, because Yahweh is his refuge.
Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.
They will be dismayed and confounded, because of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.
Israel will be saved by Yahweh with an everlasting salvation. You will not be disappointed nor confounded to ages…
Has a nation changed its gods, which really are no gods? But my people have changed their glory for that which doesn’t…
As they were multiplied, so they sinned against me. I will change their glory into shame.
that, as it is written, “He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”
Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
Don’t turn away to go after vain things which can’t profit or deliver, for they are vain.
No one sues in righteousness, and no one pleads in truth. They trust in vanity, and speak lies. They conceive mischief…
Yahweh says, “What unrighteousness have your fathers found in me, that they have gone far from me, and have walked…
Those who regard lying vanities forsake their own mercy.
You will destroy those who speak lies. Yahweh abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.
The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.
But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies…
“They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood. They have grown strong in the land, but not for truth; for they…
Therefore putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor. For we are members of one another.

translations.web: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood?
translations.bsb: How long, O men, will my honor be maligned? How long will you love vanity and seek after lies ? Selah
translations.kjv: O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.
translations.asv: O ye sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? How long will ye love vanity, and seek after falsehood? Selah
